description:
Standing epic for the beadwork-skills maintenance loop.

Sources monitored each week:
- jallum/beadwork (tool) via gh: releases, commits, merged PRs, changelog
- Beadwork Discord #general via Chrome: workflow / author / ecosystem signal
- denson/beadwork-skills (this repo) via git + live published AGENTS.md

When the tool or community surfaces a change, file a child ticket here with: source, what changed, which doc/skill + section, proposed edit, acceptance check.

Discipline: author = Denson Smith; jallum = tool author. Ticket branch is LOCAL-ONLY (never pushed).
title: Steward: keep beadwork-skills current with bw + community
